Key.Original: I have a mission for you, check the task menu for details.
Key.Korean: 할 임무가 있습니다. 자세한 내용은 임무 메뉴를 확인하십시오.
Key.Russian: У меня есть для вас задание, подробности смотрите в меню задач.

Key.Original: I already gave you that type of mission, check your task menu.
Key.Korean: 이미 해당 유형의 임무를 주었습니다. 임무 메뉴를 확인하십시오.
Key.Russian: Я уже давал вам задания такого типа, проверьте свое меню задач.

Key.Original: I have no assassination missions for you.
I have no Conquest missions for you.
I have no Convoy missions for you.
I have no Destroy missions for you.
I have no Logistics missions for you.
I have no Support missions for you.
I have no Rescue missions for you.
Assassination missions require enemy cities, airbases, or SF-patrolled areas within 4km of HQ.
Key.Korean: 암살 임무에는 본부로부터 4km 이내의 도시, 공군 기지 또는 특수부대 순찰 구역이 필요합니다.
Key.Russian: Миссии по уничтожению требуют наличия городов, авиабаз или патрулируемых районов в радиусе 4 км от штаба.

Key.Original: Conquest missions require outposts, roadblocks, or resource markers within 4km of HQ.
Key.Korean: 점령 임무는 본부로부터 4km 이내에 전초기지, 검문소 또는 자원채취소가 필요합니다.
Key.Russian: Для миссий по захвату требуются аванпосты, блокпосты или ресурсы в радиусе 4 км от штаба.

Key.Original: Convoy missions require two idle bases with a road route near HQ, and no major attacks in progress.
Destroy missions require airbases or enemy radio towers within 4km of HQ.
Key.Korean: 파괴 임무에는 본부로부터 4km 이내에 있는 공군 기지나 적 통신탑이 필요합니다.
Key.Russian: Для выполнения миссий по уничтожению требуются авиабазы или радиовышки противника в радиусе 4 км от штаба.

Key.Original: Logistics missions require outposts, seaports, or banks within 4km of HQ.
Key.Korean: 병참 임무에는 본부로부터 4km 이내에 전초기지, 항구 또는 은행이 필요합니다.
Key.Russian: Для логистических миссий требуются аванпосты, морские порты или банки в радиусе 4 км от штаба.

Key.Original: Rescue missions are random, but you need cities or outposts within 4km of HQ.
Key.Korean: 구출 임무는 무작위이지만 본부로부터 4km 이내에 도시나 전초기지가 필요합니다.
Key.Russian: Спасательные миссии проводятся случайным образом, но вам нужны города или аванпосты в радиусе 4 км от штаба

Key.Original: Support missions require cities within 4km of HQ.
Key.Korean: 지원 임무에는 본부로부터 4km 이내에 도시가 필요합니다.
Key.Russian: Для миссий поддержки требуются города в радиусе 4 км от штаба.

Key.Original: That mission is no longer available.

Key.Original: Our people are too close to that place, the enemy would notice. Pull back or pick another mission.
Key.Polish: Nasi ludzie są za blisko tego miejsca, wróg by to zauważył. Wycofajcie się albo wybierzcie inną misję.

Key.Original: Kill the Officer
A %1 officer is inspecting %2. Go there and kill him before %3.
SpecOps
We have spotted a %1 SpecOp team patrolling around a %2. Ambush them and we will have one less problem. Do this before %3. Be careful, they are tough boys.
Resource Acquisition
A %1 would be a fine addition to our cause. Go there and capture it before %2.
Take the Outpost
A %1 is disturbing our operations in the area. Go there and capture it before %2.
Secure the Seaport
%1 is an important fishing supplier for our local Fish&Chips dinners. Go there and capture it before %2.
Reclaim means of production
%1 is being used to aid the enemy. Go there and capture it before %2.
Battle for %1

This is our chance to turn %1 to our side. An uprising has been prepared, and the enemy have sent a suppression force. Talk to the town's local leader at the task marker or attack the enemy forces before %2 to start the battle.
Trigger the uprising
We have lost our opportunity. We will need to rebuild support in %1 before we have another chance to take it.
The uprising in %1 has begun! Help them destroy the oppressors before %2 and the city will be ours.
The battle for %1 has started!
Glorious victory in %1! The oppressors will not dare to return after this humiliation.
The uprising has been defeated. We will need to rebuild support in %1 before we have another chance to take it.
City Supplies

%1 population is in need of supplies. We may improve our relationship with that city if we are the ones who provide them. I have placed a crate with supplies near our HQ. Deliver the crate to %1 city center, hold it there for %3 minutes and it's done. Do this before %2.
Distribution paused. We need friendly units close to the shipment and no enemies.
Keep distributing supplies for %1 more seconds.
Supplies Delivered.
Supplies Delivered. There's no sign of enemies nearby so we can leave the locals to unload.
Supply delivery failed.
Weapons Truck
Rebel observers have reported that an enemy truck carrying valuable weapons has broken down, and repairs won't be completed until %1. Steal the crate from the truck and return it to our HQ.
The enemy have been alerted and may try to escape with the cargo. Don't let them.
Rescue hostage
A rebel commander's cousin is being held hostage in %1. Reach them before %2 and extract them to rebel territory.
I'm glad you're here. Take me to any rebel location and I'll figure it out from there.
We've recovered the hostage. Take them to any rebel location by %1.
Are you even trying to get anywhere? I'll find my own way out.
Deal with corrupt cop
A corrupt cop in %1 has been harassing civilians even more than usual. We've figured out some of his routine. Deal with him before %2.
Good riddance. He won't be bothering anyone again.
"Looks like you've convinced the scumbag of the error of his ways. We'll find a good use for his talents.
We've lost track of the target. Maybe another time.
Recover rebel vehicle
A rebel vehicle carrying hidden contraband broke down in %1, and the cops are sniffing around it. Get it to the marked safehouse nearby before %2 so we can recover the goods.
Safehouse
Good, you've brought the vehicle. Now keep our agent covered while he extracts the goods.
Leave the vehicle parked near the house or we can't work on it!
Keep the agent covered for %1 more seconds
Excellent, we've recovered the goods. You can keep the vehicle if you like. We've left some presents in it.
Clear the minefield

The enemy has mined a field on the edge of %1 and the locals have marked the %2 mines they found. Remove every one of them before %3: engineers can disarm them, explosives set them off. Everyone who helps clear the field gets %4 €.
Mine removed. %1 left in the field.
The field is clear and the people of %1 won't forget it. You have been paid %2 €.
The locals got tired of waiting and fenced the minefield off themselves.
Transport rebel agent
A rebel agent in %1 needs an escort for important business. He'll make it worth our trouble if we help him. Pick him up before %2. Make sure you bring a vehicle.
Tell him to follow you
The rebel agent has joined your squad. Take him to his destination in %1.
We've picked up the rebel agent. Get him safely to his destination in %1 before %2.
Are you just driving me around in circles? I'm outta here.
Escort defecting officer

A %1 officer stationed near %2 wants out and is offering intel and money for safe passage. They are waiting in a civilian car at the marked spot until %3. Bring a vehicle: once you pick them up their own side will come looking. Get them alive to %4.
our HQ or any of our airbases
our seaport at %1, where a boat will take them off the island
Tell the officer to follow you
The officer is with you. Their side knows they are missing, so expect company on the road. Get them alive to %1.
We have the defector. Get them alive to %1 before %2. If they die, everything they know dies with them.
The defector is safe. They handed over %1 € and everything they know about %2's plans.
The boat is waiting at the pier. The defector is on their way off the island.
The defector is dead. Whatever they knew died with them.
The officer gave up waiting for us and slipped away.
The defector has lost faith in us and made off on their own.
Lost Ammo Supplies

%1 lost a large ammo crate while moving supplies, and nobody knows exactly where it came down. %2 locals saw it fall. They are marked on the map with an arrow pointing where they saw it fall, and each bearing can be off by up to 5 degrees: follow the arrows to where they cross to find the crate. Load it onto a truck and bring it to our HQ or one of our outposts or airbases before %4. In 20 to 40 minutes %1 will send a recovery team from %3 to take it back.
Witness %1: %2°
Radio intercept: %1 has sent a recovery team and a truck from %2 for the lost crate.
We found the crate. Load it onto a truck and get it to our HQ or one of our outposts or airbases.
We found the lost ammo crate. Load it onto a truck and bring it to our HQ or one of our outposts or airbases before %1, and keep it away from the enemy recovery team.
The enemy has loaded the crate onto a truck heading for %1. Stop it before it gets there.
%1 has the crate on a truck heading for %2. Stop the truck and bring the crate to our HQ or one of our outposts or airbases before %3.
The ammo crate is ours: 300 € for the war chest, and everything inside it.
The enemy got the crate back to %1.
The trail has gone cold. The ammo crate is lost.
Abandoned Collaborator Hideout
Key.Polish: Opuszczona kryjówka kolaboranta

Key.Original: A collaborator working for %1 has fled his house near %2 in a hurry. He left his papers and a crate of supplies behind. Locals only know it is one of the houses in the marked area: search them and take his papers before %3. Everyone who takes part is paid %4 €, and whatever is in his crate is ours to keep.
Key.Polish: Kolaborant pracujący dla %1 w pośpiechu uciekł ze swojego domu w pobliżu %2. Zostawił dokumenty i skrzynię z zapasami. Miejscowi wiedzą tylko, że to jeden z domów w zaznaczonym obszarze: przeszukajcie je i zabierzcie jego dokumenty przed %3. Każdy, kto weźmie udział, dostanie %4 €, a zawartość skrzyni należy do nas.

Key.Original: Take the collaborator's papers
Key.Polish: Zabierz dokumenty kolaboranta

Key.Original: You found the collaborator's papers. You were paid %1 € for your part.
Key.Polish: Znaleźliście dokumenty kolaboranta. Otrzymujesz %1 € za swój udział.

Key.Original: The collaborator's house was destroyed, and his papers with it.
Key.Polish: Dom kolaboranta został zniszczony, a razem z nim jego dokumenty.

Key.Original: The collaborator came back for his papers. They are gone.
Key.Polish: Kolaborant wrócił po swoje dokumenty. Już ich nie ma.

Key.Original: Buying Intel
Key.Polish: Kupno informacji

Key.Original: A %1 officer in %2 will sell us intel for a %3 € bribe. A truck is waiting at HQ: load the bribe into it from your own money (it stays locked until the whole sum is in), drive it to him, park it within %4 m of him and hand the money over in person. Go undercover. If his people spot armed rebels in %2, he drives back to his outpost, and he opens fire on anyone who walks up to him openly. He waits until %5. The truck is ours to keep.
Key.Polish: Oficer sił %1 w %2 sprzeda nam informacje za łapówkę w wysokości %3 €. W kwaterze czeka ciężarówka: załadujcie do niej łapówkę z własnych pieniędzy (pozostaje zamknięta, dopóki nie będzie całej sumy), zawieźcie ją do niego, zaparkujcie w promieniu %4 m od niego i przekażcie mu pieniądze osobiście. Działajcie pod przykrywką. Jeśli jego ludzie zauważą w %2 uzbrojonych rebeliantów, odjedzie do swojego posterunku, a do każdego, kto podejdzie do niego otwarcie, otworzy ogień. Czeka do %5. Ciężarówka zostaje u nas.

Key.Original: Load bribe money
Key.Polish: Załaduj pieniądze na łapówkę

Key.Original: Hand over the bribe
Key.Polish: Wręcz łapówkę

Key.Original: You loaded %1 € into the truck. It now carries %2 of the %3 € bribe.
Key.Polish: Załadowano %1 € do ciężarówki. Jest w niej teraz %2 z %3 € łapówki.

Key.Original: You do not have %1 €.
Key.Polish: Nie masz %1 €.

Key.Original: The whole bribe is loaded and the money truck is unlocked. Drive it to the officer.
Key.Polish: Cała łapówka jest załadowana, a ciężarówka z pieniędzmi otwarta. Zawieźcie ją do oficera.

Key.Original: The officer took the money and is driving back to his outpost. His intel is ours.
Key.Polish: Oficer wziął pieniądze i wraca do swojego posterunku. Jego informacje są nasze.

Key.Original: The officer's people spotted armed rebels in %1. He is driving back to his outpost, the deal is off.
Key.Polish: Ludzie oficera zauważyli uzbrojonych rebeliantów w %1. Wraca do swojego posterunku, umowa jest zerwana.

Key.Original: The officer saw armed rebels coming for him and opened fire. The deal is off.
Key.Polish: Oficer zobaczył zbliżających się uzbrojonych rebeliantów i otworzył ogień. Umowa jest zerwana.

Key.Original: The officer is dead. The deal is off.
Key.Polish: Oficer nie żyje. Umowa jest zerwana.

Key.Original: The money truck is lost. The officer is driving off, the deal is off.
Key.Polish: Ciężarówka z pieniędzmi przepadła. Oficer odjeżdża, umowa jest zerwana.

Key.Original: The officer got tired of waiting and is driving back to his outpost.
Key.Polish: Oficer zmęczył się czekaniem i wraca do swojego posterunku.

Key.Original: The truck still carries %1 € of bribe money. Drive it back to HQ to return the money to our funds.
Key.Polish: W ciężarówce wciąż jest %1 € z łapówki. Odwieźcie ją do kwatery, żeby pieniądze wróciły do naszych funduszy.

Key.Original: The money truck is back at HQ. %1 € went back into our funds.
Key.Polish: Ciężarówka z pieniędzmi wróciła do kwatery. %1 € wróciło do naszych funduszy.

Key.Original: Destroy enemy camp

Our scouts report that a %1 squad has pitched camp in the woods near %2. We only know roughly where: search the marked area, deal with the soldiers and burn the camp down before %3. Everyone who takes part is paid %4 €.
Burn the camp
The camp is clear. Burn it down with the action at the campfire.
The enemy camp is burning. You were paid %1 € for your part.
The enemy has broken camp and moved on.
Supplies for the Elderly

An elder living alone outside %1 can no longer make it into town for food and medicine. I have placed a crate of supplies near our HQ. Bring it to their house at the marked spot and unload it there before %2. There is no pay in this, but people in %1 will hear who looked after their old folks. We don't expect any enemy activity at the house, just keep an eye out for patrols on the way.
The supplies are at the door. The old folks can't pay, but %1 will remember who helped them.
The elder we were supposed to help is dead. %1 won't forget it.
We took too long. Neighbours from %1 brought the elder what they needed, so our crate isn't needed any more.
The supply crate is lost. The delivery is off.
Steal or Destroy Ammotruck
We've spotted an Ammotruck in an %1. Go there and destroy or steal it before %2.%2.
Ammo Truck Destroyed.
Ammo Truck Captured.
Collaborator Car Ambush
Key.Polish: Zasadzka na kolaboranta

Key.Original: A collaborator in %1 has been passing information about us to the %2. The police will drive him from %1 to %3, leaving at %4. Kill him before he gets there.
Key.Polish: Kolaborant z %1 przekazuje informacje o nas siłom %2. Policja zawiezie go z %1 do %3, wyjazd o %4. Zabij go, zanim tam dotrze.

Key.Original: The police car with the collaborator has left %1 and is heading for %2. Kill him before he gets there.
Key.Polish: Radiowóz z kolaborantem wyjechał z %1 i jedzie do %2. Zabij go, zanim tam dotrze.

Key.Original: The police have spotted us. The collaborator's car is leaving now!
Key.Polish: Policja nas zauważyła. Samochód z kolaborantem właśnie odjeżdża!

Key.Original: Their outpost has fallen. The police are taking the collaborator to %1 instead.
Key.Polish: Ich posterunek padł. Policja wiezie kolaboranta do %1.

Key.Original: The collaborator is dead.
Key.Polish: Kolaborant nie żyje.

Key.Original: The collaborator got through. The enemy now knows more about our HQ.
Key.Polish: Kolaborant dotarł na miejsce. Wróg wie teraz więcej o naszej kwaterze.
